seo.title: Sound Design | Igor Szuniewicz
seo.description: Sound redesigns and implementation showcases — God of War combat, Baldur's Gate spells, weapon synthesis, and sci-fi ambience.

hero.title: Sound Design Work
hero.subtitle: Combat redesigns, spell FX, weapon synthesis, and sci-fi ambience. All original recordings and processing.

video1.title: God of War — Combat Redesign
video1.description: Stripped the original audio and replaced it with my own field recordings and foley. Axe impacts, shield blocks, enemy screams, environmental destruction — all recorded, processed, and mixed in Reaper.

video2.title: Baldur's Gate 3 — Spell FX Remake
video2.description: Rebuilt the spell effects from scratch using layered synthesizers and processed recordings. Fire, ice, arcane — each element built from original source material.

video3.title: Weapon Sound Design
video3.description: Two weapons, two worlds. A P2000 pistol built from realistic recordings and foley. A sci-fi energy weapon built from synthesizers and experimental processing.

video4.title: Fractured Horizon
video4.description: My first sound design project. Replaced all audio for a sci-fi scene: spaceship hum, alarm systems, mechanical doors. Simple work, but it taught me the fundamentals of syncing sound to picture.
